fusions.name: Grit in the Wound
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. A weapon strike that deals 8 rock damage, leaves it 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds and [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Erupting Burrows
fusions.desc: Bursts the ground in a cone 5 tiles ahead of you that deals 30 rock damage to everything in it, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, and leaves them [Poisoned] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Mason's Rampart
fusions.desc: Raises a wall of packed nest 5 tiles long for 6 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

fusions.name: Kicked Mound
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. At 8 they all spend at once: a blow strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 20% of your weapon damage per stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
